ssa_source.source_title: Period Life Table, 2023, as used in the 2026 Trustees Report
ssa_source.retrieval: Official SSA HTML parsed by web tool; direct CLI download returned HTTP403. Selected rows extracted programmatically from the official rendered table and independently cross-checked against the displayed age/sex columns.
ssa_source.definition: Mean remaining years at exact age under 2023 period mortality rates; attained-age benchmark is exact age plus remaining years.

records.app_headline: You're likely to live to about 83. Most people like you live to between 77 and 92.
records.app_caveat: Proof of concept: a rough estimate, not a prediction for you. It repeats the survey model's one-year risk at each later age with your answers held fixed, so it can never be truly accurate. LifeTwin then focuses on your relative health score. The model was only checked up to age 79, so the ages past that are a rougher guess. Near the edge of the ages the model was checked on, this leans mostly on the 2024 US life table, so it is even rougher.
